text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Moonlight is an open-source game streaming client that allows games running on a host computer to be played remotely on other devices. Originally created as an implementation of NVIDIA GameStream technology, it provides low-latency streaming with support for controllers, keyboards, and multiple display resolutions. Moonlight can be used to access PC games from televisions, handheld devices, and single-board computers. The software focuses on delivering PC gaming experiences to additional devices without requiring games to be installed locally.
